pages.title: About Shomoukh Early Childhood Education
pages.text:
In the Sultanate of Oman, education is a fundamental right and every child possesses boundless potential.

Inspired by the world-renowned Reggio Emilia approach from Italy, blending international excellence with authentic Omani values. Shomoukh Early Childhood Education is an International Early Years Nursery School. In our school, children are viewed as unique, capable, resilient, creative, curious, and intelligent individuals. We embrace everyone's culture while offering children a wide range of opportunities to become confident and prepare them to meet future challenges. Our students are active citizens who reach their full potential within a safe, healthy, nurturing, and aesthetic environment that respects their rights and opinions. Teaching methods are based on children's needs and interests, ensuring that every child is actively involved in the learning process and receives personal attention and guidance. Reggio Emilia Philosophy The child is recognized as having 100 languages for thinking, expressing, and learning.

Our school's ethos and culture promote positive relations among all members and provide opportunities so that each child feels fulfilled.

We believe that genuine partnerships between the school, parents, and the wider community play an important and indispensable role in the child's educational journey. Families are warmly invited to participate in school-related activities, initiate collaborative projects, and lend their active support during annual events. We strive to create a happy, stimulating environment that emphasizes the social, emotional, physical, and cognitive development of each child, preparing them for lifelong confidence.

To provide high-quality childcare services and promote the development of creativity and self-confidence of children in a positive, friendly, and respectful learning environment to prepare them for a lifelong learning experience.

To create a joyful, warm, and fun educational sanctuary that emphasizes the holistic social, emotional, physical, and mental development of each child, empowering them to become leaders of tomorrow.

We value excellence in caring, high spirits of optimism, collegiality, and community involvement. Continuous professional development is recognized as both a right and duty for every educator guiding our children.

The foundational values that guide our daily interactions, programs, and community initiatives.

At Shomoukh, we believe in diversity while deeply respecting Omani cultural heritage and values. We organize regular events and activities throughout the academic year to foster a deep sense of belonging and mutual respect.

Our school maintains close, meaningful ties with the local community in Muscat and organizes charitable events and donation drives during the academic year to actively support those in need.

We continuously promote environmental sustainability and eco-consciousness, teaching children the values of Reducing, Reusing, and Recycling through our hands-on organic garden activities.

Your child's physical health, emotional well-being, and security are our highest priorities. Our safety protocols and hygiene standards are the highest in the early childhood industry, meeting and exceeding all Ministry guidelines.

The first and only Reggio Emilia inspired nursery school in the Sultanate of Oman, combining UK EYFS curriculum excellence with authentic Omani values.

pages.title: Educational Programs & UK EYFS Framework
topics: We Meet Kids Where They Are
pages.text:
Nurturing curiosity, independent inquiry, and the joys of childhood through project-based early education.

At Shomoukh, we know childhood is a treasured time. We provide environments and experiences that capture the joys of growing up. We believe it is our responsibility to provide environments and experiences that nurture each child's individual growth and development, paving the way for lifelong success in school and beyond.

Shomoukh operates twelve (12) months per year, following a three-term academic year alongside an engaging summer camp. Working in small groups, students explore their environment and continuously enhance their skills.

An educational experience built on international research and responsive teaching.

Thoughtfully and carefully designed nursery environments, programs, and schedules – all created with the developmental needs of both children and working parents in mind.

Dedicated early childhood professionals fully engaged in teaching careers, who benefit from ongoing training, mentoring, and continuous pedagogical growth.

Research-informed curriculum designed by experienced early years educators to inspire children not merely to memorize, but to question, hypothesize, and think on their own.

Shomoukh follows the Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS) curriculum, a UK-based system setting milestones in learning, personal, and emotional development for children from birth to five years of age. It establishes rigorous standards for welfare and child safety in supportive environments. The EYFS framework seamlessly integrates with the Reggio Emilia philosophy of project-based learning, where every child is driven by their genuine interests as equal partners in discovery alongside parents and teachers.

Teachers at Shomoukh are researchers learning alongside the children. They observe, document, and interpret children's exploration, nurturing natural curiosity through open-ended activities rather than rigid scripts.

Classrooms and open-air patios act as provocations for exploration. Interconnected learning spaces support dialogue, light observation, and multi-sensory experiments.

Immersive bilingual exposure nurturing native Arabic foundations alongside English fluency.

Gross motor development, yoga, gymnastics, and energetic games refining balance and body control.

Developing hand strength, finger dexterity, pencil grip, and joyful mark-making for school readiness.

records.answer: GES describes its mission as providing education that encourages curiosity, lifelong learning, individual potential and a positive contribution to the world.

records.title: GES values — ELEVATE
records.question: Tell me about GES values — ELEVATE
records.answer: GES names its ELEVATE values as Excellence, Leadership, Equity, Vision, Adaptability, Technology and Empowerment.

records.title: GES published school count
records.question: Tell me about GES published school count
records.answer: The GES homepage displays a count of four schools. Its About page names SIPS, Shomoukh ECE Al Qurum and Shomoukh ECE Al Mouj. The reviewed pages do not identify a fourth institution, so ask GES to confirm the complete current list. Shomoukh Nursery itself has two published Muscat campuses.

conflicts.description: Published age ranges differ: the programs introduction says 6 months to 4 years; the infant card says 3–11 months; admissions says 6 months to 6 years. Confirm eligibility with admissions.
